purpose: Pre-registered semantic oracle for WBS3 C2. Review model answers against these seeded defects; do not invent post-hoc acceptance criteria.

required_claims: clearing the list being iterated after the first put causes later staged writes to be skipped
a two-write transaction can persist alpha while failing to persist beta
A.required_reproduction: Stage at least two distinct writes, call commit, and assert both writes are present.
acceptable_fixes: copy/drain pending atomically and clear only after all entries have been applied
disallowed_substitutions: claim that PageIndex.version must count distinct keys
claim an unspecified multithreaded dictionary race is the seeded defect

required_claims: the explicit await asyncio.sleep(0) yields after the nonempty check and before heapq.heappop
with one queued job, two workers can both pass the nonempty check before either pop completes
after one worker removes the only item, the other worker can execute heappop on an empty heap and raise IndexError
B.required_reproduction: Queue one job and concurrently await two Worker.run_once calls on the same queue; assert one execution, one None result, and no exception.
acceptable_fixes: remove the yield so check and pop are atomic with respect to cooperative task switching
protect the check/pop critical section with an asyncio.Lock
disallowed_substitutions: claim thread preemption between non-await statements
claim the old v1 check-to-pop race where no await existed
